name: How long does window casing repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window casing repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window casing repair depends on the scope of work. Minor repairs, such as filling small cracks or replacing a short section of trim, might only take a few hours per window. Extensive damage requiring full casing replacement for multiple windows, or dealing with underlying rot, could take several days. Factors like custom molding creation or extensive prep work can also extend the timeline. Your contractor can provide an estimated timeframe after assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor fixes to several days for extensive work on multiple windows. Customization or underlying damage can extend the duration.
